title: ISINSCOPE is FALSE on the total row that ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL adds
query: ORDER BY [Is Total] ASC, Product[Color] ASC

source.quote: This is why at the grand total Brand neither has one value, nor is it in scope.
source.supports: the grouped column is not in scope at the total computed by ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL

source.quote: adds a new column to the result indicating -- whether the current row is a subtotal or not
source.supports: the named column is TRUE on the total row, whose group column is blank

derivation: Three detail rows, one per color, with [Is Total] FALSE and the color in scope. One total row with a blank color and [Is Total] TRUE, where no grouping is active and ISINSCOPE is FALSE. FALSE sorts before TRUE, so the total is last whatever the position of BLANK.
